name: Empty types
description:
Allow object types, interfaces and input objects with no fields, unions with no members and enums with no values:

```graphql
type Query {
  topAuthors: [Author!]
}
type Author {
  name: String!
  topBooks: [Book!]
}
# all of these are valid
type Book
interface Marker
input Filter
union Nothing
enum Never
```

This is useful to represent partial schemas (for example subschemas extracted from a larger schema to feed an LLM), to deprecate all the fields of a type without making the schema invalid, and avoids having to pick unions over interfaces only because interfaces must have fields.
